This fruit is found chiefly in mild temperate climates, especially in freshwater banks and shores, and is best known in south-eastern Endor. Even in suitable terrain, it remains of medium difficulty to find.

The flesh of a Bramblerose fruit restores 4–10 concussion hits. Two fruits also provide enough nourishment to feed a Man for one day. The seeds, however, cause violent intestinal pain, so the edible flesh must be carefully separated from them before consumption.
